name: @techspokes/typescript-wsdl-client
description: Turn legacy WSDL/SOAP services into typed TypeScript clients, OpenAPI 3.1 specs, and production-ready Fastify REST gateways. Built for enterprise SOAP modernization.
author: TechSpokes <contact@techspokes.com> (https://www.techspokes.com)

scripts.test:github: vitest run test/unit test/snapshot test/integration test/tooling --exclude "**/*installed.test.ts"
scripts.test:platform: vitest run test/unit/checked-assessment.test.ts test/unit/direct-operation.test.ts test/unit/direct-structure.test.ts test/unit/direct-structure-evidence.test.ts test/unit/direct-values.test.ts test/unit/direct-codec.test.ts test/unit/direct-codec-independent.test.ts test/unit/direct-source-capsule.test.ts test/unit/direct-capsule-independent.test.ts test/unit/generated-direct-independent.test.ts test/unit/direct-resource-limits.test.ts test/unit/direct-resource-limits-independent.test.ts test/unit/checked-direct-runtime.test.ts test/integration/direct-normal-execution.test.ts test/integration/noaa-ndfd-qualification.test.ts test/tooling/readiness-inventory.test.ts test/integration/owned-node-process.test.ts test/unit/schema-resource-cancellation.test.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run package:validate
scripts.smoke:compile: npm run smoke:reset && tsx src/cli.ts compile --wsdl-source examples/minimal/weather.wsdl --catalog-file tmp/smoke/catalog.json
scripts.smoke:client: npm run smoke:reset && tsx src/cli.ts client --wsdl-source examples/minimal/weather.wsdl --client-dir tmp/smoke/client && tsc -p tsconfig.smoke.json
scripts.smoke:openapi: npm run smoke:reset && tsx src/cli.ts openapi --wsdl-source examples/minimal/weather.wsdl --openapi-file tmp/smoke/openapi.json --openapi-format json && tsc -p tsconfig.smoke.json
scripts.smoke:gateway: npm run smoke:reset && tsx src/cli.ts client --wsdl-source examples/minimal/weather.wsdl --client-dir tmp/smoke/client && tsx src/cli.ts openapi --catalog-file tmp/smoke/client/catalog.json --openapi-file tmp/smoke/openapi.json --openapi-format json && tsx src/cli.ts gateway --openapi-file tmp/smoke/openapi.json --client-dir tmp/smoke/client --gateway-dir tmp/smoke/gateway --gateway-service-name weather --gateway-version-prefix v1 && tsc -p tsconfig.smoke.json
scripts.smoke:pipeline: npm run smoke:reset && tsx src/cli.ts pipeline --wsdl-source examples/minimal/weather.wsdl --client-dir tmp/smoke/client --openapi-file tmp/smoke/openapi.json --gateway-dir tmp/smoke/gateway --gateway-service-name weather --gateway-version-prefix v1 --openapi-format json --init-app && tsc -p tsconfig.smoke.json
scripts.smoke:app: npm run smoke:reset && tsx src/cli.ts pipeline --wsdl-source examples/minimal/weather.wsdl --client-dir tmp/smoke/client --openapi-file tmp/smoke/openapi.json --gateway-dir tmp/smoke/gateway --gateway-service-name weather --gateway-version-prefix v1 --openapi-format json --openapi-servers https://example.com/api && tsx src/cli.ts app --client-dir tmp/smoke/client --gateway-dir tmp/smoke/gateway --openapi-file tmp/smoke/openapi.json --app-dir tmp/smoke/app --port 8080 && tsc -p tsconfig.smoke.json
scripts.docs:validate: node scripts/validate-docs.mjs && npm run docs:support-matrix:check && npm run docs:corpus:check
scripts.release:publish-check: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run skill:validate && npm run package:validate
scripts.ci:run: npm run check:toolchain && npm run typecheck:tooling && npm run typecheck:reference && npm run clean && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test:reference && npm run typecheck:integration && npm run skill:validate && npm run package:validate && npm run docs:validate && vitest run --exclude "test/conformance/reference/**" --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile=tmp/conformance/product-tests.json && npm run smoke:pipeline && npm run package:smoke
scripts.ci:github: npm run check:toolchain && npm run typecheck:tooling && npm run typecheck:reference && npm run clean && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test:reference && npm run typecheck:integration && npm run skill:validate && npm run package:validate && npm run docs:validate && npm run test:github && npm run smoke:pipeline
scripts.ci:github:node26: npm run check:toolchain && npm run typecheck:tooling && npm run typecheck:reference && npm run clean && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test:reference && npm run typecheck:integration && npm run test:unit && vitest run test/tooling test/integration/client-imports.test.ts && npm run smoke:pipeline
scripts.examples:regenerate: tsx src/cli.ts pipeline --wsdl-source examples/minimal/weather.wsdl --client-dir examples/generated-output/client --openapi-file examples/generated-output/openapi.json --gateway-dir examples/generated-output/gateway --gateway-service-name weather --gateway-version-prefix v1 --openapi-format json
scripts.research:ci: npm run check:toolchain && npm run research:typecheck && npm run research:docs && npm run research:test
